Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGU Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for RGU Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Field Investigator posts at Rajiv Gandhi University is scheduled for 20 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in any Social Science discipline, specifically social work or psychology, with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Field Investigator position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi University is recruiting for a total of 2 vacancies for the Field Investigator position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the RGU Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Rajiv Gandhi University (RGU) office in Doimukh, Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit for the Field Investigator position. It is advisable to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator position is a contractual role at Rajiv Gandhi University.
